caveat: A figure present in the reply is an UPPER BOUND on use — the model may have recited it from weights. So this is a LOWER BOUND on the discard rate.

rows.question: nimefungua duka miezi sita iliyopita nimeuza jumla milioni 60 hadi sasa je nimefika kiwango cha vat
forced_facts: Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT: mauzo ya TZS 100,000,000 kwa miezi 6.
Kizingiti cha kusajili VAT: mauzo ya TZS 200,000,000 kwa miezi 12.
rows.reply: Kwa upande wa miezi 6 mfululizo: hapana, mauzo yako ya TZS 60,000,000 hayajafikia kizingiti cha TZS 100,000,000. LAKINI hili halijamalizika: usajili wa VAT ni wa lazima pia IKIWA mauzo yamefikia TZS 200,000,000 katika miezi 12. Sijui mauzo yako ya miezi 12, hivyo kama yamefikia kiasi hicho, unatakiwa kujisajili. Niambie mauzo ya miezi 12 nami nitathibitisha. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: kama mgeni akikutwa anafanya biashara isiyoruhusiwa adhabu yake ni ipi
forced_facts: Faini kwa mgeni (raia wa kigeni) anayevunja GN487A: si chini ya TZS 10,000,000 (milioni kumi), na/au kifungo miezi 6, na kufutwa kwa visa.
rows.why: GN487A non-citizen fine — control, already retrieved
rows.reply: Kwa mujibu wa Government Notice No. 487A, mgeni atakayekutwa anafanya shughuli iliyopigwa marufuku anakabiliwa na faini isiyo pungua TZS 10,000,000 au kifungo cha miezi sita, na kufutwa kwa visa na kibali cha ukaazi kunaweza kutokea kama sehemu ya adhabu -- thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz). Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).

rows.question: mgeni anaweza kuwa mwanahisa kwenye kampuni yangu ya ujenzi bila kuendesha biashara ya rejareja
forced_facts: gn487a shareholder vs operator distinction: GN487A prohibits non-citizens from CONDUCTING or OPERATING the listed business activities. Passive shareholding or investment in a Tanzanian-owned and operated company is not explicitly prohibited by GN487A - the prohibition targets the person carrying out the activity, not the investor. However, a non-citizen who is a shareholder AND actively manages or operates the business would be covered. Consult an immigration lawyer for specific structures.
rows.reply: Kampuni ya ujenzi ni shughuli iliyozuiliwa kwa wasio raia chini ya GN 487A. Hivyo, mgeni kuwa mwanahisa katika kampuni hiyo kunaweza kumfanya ashindwe kufuata sheria. Thibitisha na Idara ya Uhamiaji (immigration.go.tz).

rows.reply: Kusajili kampuni kunakugharimu shilingi 95,000 TZS. Thibitisha na BRELA (brela.go.tz). Kuhifadhi jina la kampuni ni 50,000 TZS.

rows.question: mauzo yangu ya mwaka ni milioni 15 na sijasajili vat je nahitaji mashine ya risiti
forced_facts: Kizingiti cha kuanza kutumia mashine ya EFD: mauzo ya TZS 11,000,000 (milioni kumi na moja) kwa mwaka. Si TZS 200,000,000 — hiyo ni kizingiti cha kusajili VAT, si EFD. Biashara zote zilizosajiliwa VAT hutumia EFD bila kujali kiwango cha mauzo.
rows.why: EFD threshold 11M — never retrieved, answered from weights
rows.reply: Ndiyo, unatakiwa kuwa na mashine ya EFD. Mauzo yako ya mwaka ya TZS 15,000,000 yamefikia au kuzidi kizingiti cha TZS 11,000,000. Thibitisha na TRA (tra.go.tz).

rows.question: nina duka dogo na mfanyakazi mmoja je nasajili sehemu ya kazi osha
forced_facts: Nina wafanyakazi wawili tu (au mmoja) dukani — je bado najisajili mahali fulani? Ndiyo. OSHA husajili maeneo YOTE ya kazi bila kikomo cha idadi ya wafanyakazi, na WCF huanza tangu mfanyakazi wa kwanza. Idadi ndogo ya wafanyakazi HAIONDOI wajibu wa kujisajili OSHA na WCF (mfuko wa fidia).
rows.reply: Ndiyo, unatakiwa kusajili sehemu yako ya kazi kwa OSHA. Thibitisha na OSHA (osha.go.tz).

rows.question: nani anakuja kukagua usalama wa sehemu yangu ya kazi na nani analipa fidia akiumia
forced_facts: OSHA na WCF ni taasisi mbili tofauti. OSHA husajili mahali pa kazi (kifungu 16, Sheria ya OSHA Na.5 ya 2003), hukagua, na hutoa leseni ya utii kila mwaka — OSHA HAILIPI fidia ya ajali. Fidia ya ajali na magonjwa ya kazini hulipwa na WCF (mwajiri huchangia 0.5% ya mishahara). Usajili wa OSHA na wa WCF ni tofauti; vyote vinahitajika. WCF huanza tangu mfanyakazi wa kwanza — HAKUNA kizingiti cha wafanyakazi wawili.
rows.why: OSHA-vs-WCF distinction — the fact carrying the claim was NOT retrieved
rows.reply: Kuna taasisi mbili tofauti zinazohusiana na usalama na afya kazini. Moja ni OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Authority) ambayo ndiyo inayokuja kukagua na kusimamia usalama katika eneo lako la kazi. Nyingine ni WCF (Workers Compensation Fund) ambao ndio wanakupa fidia pale mfanyakazi anapopata ajali. Thibitisha na osha.go.tz na wcf.go.tz.

rows.question: mimi ni mkulima nina vibarua je kima cha chini kinatofautiana kwa sekta
forced_facts: Kima cha chini cha mshahara (GN 605A): hakina kiwango kimoja kwa nchi nzima — kila sekta ina chake, sekta 16 na sekta ndogo 46. Mkulima / sekta ya kilimo ina kiwango chake tofauti na sekta nyingine.
rows.reply: Ndiyo, kuna viwango tofauti kulingana na sekta. Thibitisha na MLYWF (mlywf.go.tz).

rows.question: nimeuzia wakala wa serikali bidhaa je watanikata asilimia ngapi ya vat
forced_facts: vat withholding goods: VAT withholding on goods is 3% of the consideration (invoice value exclusive of VAT) — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025, VAT Act s.5(5)). The standard 18% VAT rate is split: the withholding agent remits 3% to TRA and the supplier receives the remaining 15%.
rows.why: VAT withholding goods 3% — SS8 row, was CORRECT forced
rows.reply: Kiwango cha VAT withholding kwenye bidhaa ni asilimia 3, kinachukuliwa na mnunuzi anayehitimu. Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: mfanyakazi ameumia jana nina siku ngapi za kupeleka taarifa ya ajali
forced_facts: wcf accident reporting deadline: 7 working days from date of accident. Source: Workers Compensation Act / portal.wcf.go.tz
rows.why: WCF 7 working days — SS8 row, was CORRECT forced
rows.reply: Kuna siku saba tu za kuwasilisha taarifa hiyo. Thibitisha na WCF (portal.wcf.go.tz).

rows.question: nimefanya kazi ya ushauri kwa taasisi ya serikali wamesema watakata vat je asilimia ngapi na cheti nitapata lini
forced_facts: vat withholding services: VAT withholding on services is 6% of the consideration (invoice value exclusive of VAT) — effective 1 July 2025 (Finance Act 2025, VAT Act s.5(5)). The standard 18% VAT rate is split: the withholding agent remits 6% to TRA and the supplier receives the remaining 12% (the statute states this 12% expressly).

vat withholding certificate timing: VAT withholding certificate must be issued NOT LATER THAN the date on which VAT becomes payable under section 15 of the VAT Act — NOT on the 20th of the following month. The 20th deadline applies to filing the VAT return and remitting the withheld amount, which are separate obligations. A withholding agent must issue the certificate in an approved system format containing: TIN, registration number, supply description, consideration amount, withholding rate and withholding amount.
rows.why: VAT withholding services 6% + certificate timing — SS8 row
rows.reply: Kiwango cha VAT withholding kwenye huduma ni asilimia 6, kinachukuliwa na mnunuzi anayehitimu. Cheti lazima kitolewe si baadaye ya tarehe VAT inakuwa ya kulipwa (si tarehe 20). Thibitisha na tra.go.tz.

rows.question: sijapeleka ritani ya kampuni yangu miezi saba sasa nitalipa faini kiasi gani na ada yenyewe ni ngapi

BRELA: ada ya kuwasilisha ritani (annual return) ya kampuni kila mwaka ni TZS 22,000.

rows.reply: Kama umekosea kuwasilisha annual return, utapata adhabu ya faini ya shilingi 2500 kwa kila mwezi uliopita. Thibitisha na BRELA Official (brela.go.tz).
